summary: Preserve EventEmitter's special unhandled 'error' behavior instead of treating it as an ordinary event.

target.notes: When no regular 'error' listener exists, Node throws the emitted Error (or creates an unhandled-error failure for non-Error payloads). errorMonitor listeners do not count as handling the error.

semantics.process_effect: an uncaught throw may terminate the process

caveats: Do not lower to a silent boolean false for the no-listener case.
captureRejections can generate error events asynchronously; advanced rejection routing is intentionally deferred.

tests.name: unhandled error throws same Error
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); const err=Error('x'); try{e.emit('error',err)}catch(x){console.log(x===err)}

tests.name: handled error does not throw
tests.input: const {EventEmitter}=require('node:events'); const e=new EventEmitter(); e.on('error',e=>console.log(e.message)); console.log(e.emit('error',Error('x')));
